path_selected: Path B — No eligible independent cohort exists
justification: A comprehensive audit of all repository data assets established that zero independent workload cohorts exist in the project root. Every available dataset is either: (1) already part of the Candidate A development pool, (2) directly overlapping with Candidate A entities and parent jobs from the same Google Borg 2011 cluster trace, (3) strictly prohibited by experimental governance protocol (Candidate A Test and Phase 6 Holdout), or (4) an empty directory (data/synthetic_benchmark). Under strict scientific protocol, evaluating models against non-independent partitions or prohibited test sets is forbidden. Therefore, Path B is declared.
